label: December 14–20, 2026
intro: School's out! Gingerbread building, giant Christmas lights and the countdown to Santa.
weekday_note: Most schools break from Dec 14 — the Anytime Favorites (skating, museums, pottery) are perfect for free weekdays.

activities.title: Kimpton Maa-Lai gingerbread house workshop
activities.why: Hands-on building and decorating, and he takes the house home.
activities.tip: Book ahead — the pre-Christmas weekends fill fastest.

activities.title: ICONSIAM Bangkok Illumination + Koh Kerd miniatures
activities.why: Giant tree light shows by the river plus the tiny handmade miniature worlds inside.
activities.tip: Arrive by boat from Saphan Taksin for extra adventure.

activities.title: Onederous Christmas at One Bangkok — weekend performances
activities.why: Live festive music — Thor can drum along on his knees!

activities.title: Disney & Pixar at centralwOrld + The Rink
activities.why: Pixar characters, then ice skating in the same mall — two favourites in one trip.
activities.tip: Weekday mornings the rink is nearly empty — ideal for practice.
